game_title: Divide Or Floor – Ember Fields Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Ember Fields, fields of drifting embers: the ember mage must handle molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split sulfur crystals evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ember Fields: fields of drifting embers
core_gameplay_loop: In Ember Fields, repeat each round: Pick / or // to split sulfur crystals evenly among allies without leaving fractions. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the share value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the lava bridge using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The lava bridge reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the lava bridge is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 2 (intro tier): Divide Or Floor
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Ember Fields'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how share changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against molten golems in Ember Fields.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The lava bridge reached with actions_used <= 15.
